We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

- Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. 
- Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. 
- Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. 
- Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
- Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.

What You'll Bring

- Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. 
- An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. 
- Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.

- Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus. 

What's Cool About The Role

- We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it. 
- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity. 
- Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. 
- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. - Schedule-entry timeliness

- Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling

The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. - Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
- Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
- Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
- Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
- Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
- Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.

This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. Location: Germany (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA 

Employment: 18-month FTC with view to extend 

About the role: 

We’re hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You’ll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You’ll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren’t there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you’ll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.

Key Responsibilities:

New Business and Client Engagement

- Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.

- Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.

- Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren’t present, and know when and how to bring them in.

- Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

Requirement Gathering and Analysis

- Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.

- Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.

- Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

Operating Model and Solution Design

- Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.

- Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.

- Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.

- Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

Commercial Modelling

- Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.

- Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.

- Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

Stakeholder Communication

- Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.

- Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

Data, Measurement and Reporting

- Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.

- Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

About You:

Essential

- 10-15 years’ experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.

- A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).

- Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).

- A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.

- Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.

- Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren’t in the room.

- Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.

- Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

Desirable

- Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.

- Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.

- Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

What Success Looks Like:

- Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.

- Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.

- Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.

- Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

title: Consultant
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

Location 

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with occasional visits to customers across the DACH region.

As team collaboration is of great importance to us, we highly encourage team members to join us in Zurich at least once a month. These visits are financially supported by BLP.

About the role 

For a process to run autonomously, four things have to line up: the technology, the process itself, the data behind it, and the people who work with it. That alignment does not happen at go-live. It happens in the months after, and that is where this role sits.

Our customers go live with a working solution. What they do not have on day one is an organisation that operates in an AI-native way. Processes were designed around people checking things. Data was maintained well enough for humans to interpret. Teams know the old workarounds better than the new system. Your job is to lead that transition, from a process that is automated in parts to a process that genuinely runs on its own.

That means working across every level of the customer's organisation. With operational teams you build understanding and find where automation is actually blocked. With department leads you challenge the process rules that make full automation impossible, and drive the decisions that change them. And you use the right lever for each blocker, because they are all different: some are a data clean-up you coordinate with the customer, some are a training and adoption gap, some need a custom agent, and some are structural and belong with our engineering teams.

You do not do this alone. You enable the customer's core team to solve their own issues, you work with our Customer Success Engineers on the technical side, and you use the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made where you need commercial weight. For our smaller customers, where there is no Customer Success Manager, you are the escalation point yourself.

You own customer health. Your sharpest measure of it is the automation rate.

What you'll do 

- Own customer health across your portfolio, measured first and foremost by automation rates.

- Lead the transition to AI-native ways of working: identify what blocks automation, and pick the right way to solve each blocker.

- Work with operational teams on enablement and adoption, so people work efficiently with blp rather than around it.

- Challenge process rules that prevent automation, and drive improvements with the department leads who can decide.

- Coordinate data clean-up with the customer where master data quality is capping what automation can reach.

- Enable the customer's core team to resolve issues themselves, and reduce what has to come to us at all.

- Identify where a custom agent solves the problem, and where the issue is structural and belongs with our engineering teams.

- Collaborate with Customer Success Engineers on technical topics, and with the Customer Success Manager to get decisions made.

- For customers without a Customer Success Manager, act as the escalation point for SLA breaches and own continuity of operations.

- Direct the AI Automation Specialists working on your accounts.

What we're really looking for 

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

- Process Excellence – You understand core business processes deeply, P2P and O2C, and you can see why a process is shaped the way it is and what it could look like instead.

- Client Hands – You bring customers with you. You are strict on the things that matter and flexible on the things that do not, you understand the context people are working in, and you have more than one way of convincing them.

- Ownership & Autonomy – You take a customer from live to high automation without being told the steps.

- Comfort in the Data – You go into the numbers yourself to find where automation is leaking.

- Problem Solving & Critical Thinking – You separate a configuration symptom from a process cause, and pick the right lever for each.

What you'll bring 

- Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

- 3+ years of experience in consulting, process improvement, shared services, or ERP process ownership.

- Deep working knowledge of at least one core business process end to end, purchase-to-pay or order-to-cash. This is a prerequisite, not a nice to have.

- Demonstrable experience changing how a finance, procurement or supply chain team actually works, not only advising on it.

- Strong analytical skills. You are comfortable working with process and transaction data directly.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead our regional technical market-access and integration efforts.

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to work with stakeholders to develop our DSR (Demand Side Response) and flexibility pipeline.

You will be bringing your regional technical expertise to aid the development of our asset integration technologies. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll bridge our software and hardware capabilities with the rigorous requirements of the four German Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and 900+ Distribution System Operators (DSOs).

The detailed Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware&Software) configuration and protocol engineering is owned by our UK-based team, whom you will feed with regional knowledge and design input, and who will support you on the technical aspects of how Kraken integrations work. You will own the regional relationship, the integration approach, and the design that the UK team then implements. The role may require you to attend customer calls, as well as calls with the TSO and DSOs to technically explain/defend our strategy.

- Regional Technical Expertise: Be the regional authority who feeds and supports the UK team with knowledge of German hardware requirements, industrial protocols, connectivity, cyber-security expectations, and TSO/DSO and ancillary-service requirements. - Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the technical point of contact for TSOs, DSOs, customers, and internal commercial teams to resolve connection, onboarding, or operational issues.

You’ll ideally be based close to Kraken’s Berlin office and the role requires the ability to travel when needed, though this is kept to a minimum.

- Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English , essential for technical documentation and TSO/regulator communication.

- Integration & connectivity: Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control).

- Power-plant systems: Working understanding of power-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering.

- German market knowledge: 

- TSO/DSO hierarchy and the connection/integration process.

- Ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) prequalification and technical requirements.

- Redispatch 3.0 regulatory framework.

- Customer-facing delivery: Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams.

- Travel: Occasional travel may be required.

- A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment , comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi-TSO, decentralised grid, and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK.

⭐️ Bonus points

- Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25 (wind), OPC-UA, Modbus , or similar IEC protocols.

title: Senior iOS Developer - Berlin
description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

The role

You'll be a senior engineer on the RA Guide iOS app: shaping how it's built, leading the technical design of larger features, and raising the bar on quality with the Apps lead.

RA Guide is RA's app for browsing events and buying tickets, native on iOS and Android and used by thousands of people every day. We also make RA Scan, a cross-platform app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll join the Apps team: the Apps lead (who also builds on iOS), an Android developer and a product manager, working closely with design and the web teams who build the APIs the app uses.

We release weekly. Native releases can't be rolled back once they're out, so we care about getting each one right: tests, careful review, and watching what happens after release.

Responsibilities

- Lead the technical design of larger features, including the specs that line up iOS and Android on the same APIs
- Own areas of the codebase, and modernise older parts of it safely
- Raise release quality: automated UI tests on native frameworks, crash analysis and monitoring
- Review code and mentor other developers
- Work with the web and platform teams on the APIs the app depends on
- Help shape how the team uses AI in development, and where it shouldn't.

Who we are looking for

- Several years building and releasing iOS apps used at scale
- Deep experience with Swift, app architecture and refactoring code that's already live
- Testing and coding habits for stable app releases
- You make the developers around you better, through review, pairing and clear explanation
- You can explain a technical trade-off to product and design in plain terms

If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. We'll help you grow into the rest.

Nice to have 

- SwiftUI, reactive programming and GraphQL
- A/B testing, phased rollouts and data tracking
- Monitoring tools such as Datadog
- Android or cross-platform experience
- An interest in electronic music and the scenes RA serves

What we offer you

- Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
- Matched pension, or 401k for US staff.
- Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
- Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch.
- Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
- A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity ).
- Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community ).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

- Electronic music is art.
- We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
- We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
- We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
- We use innovation to empower the community.
- We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
- We're always front left.

This role is a full-time based in our Berlin office. Please note: this position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary range for this role is €70,000- €85,000. If you have questions about the role, please contact

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction At a glance 

- Location & work model : Berlin, hybrid 
- Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester ( KubeVirt ), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph 
- Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware 
- Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team 
- Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must 
Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. 

Your first 90 days 

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.

Your mission - Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions
- Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case
- Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks
- Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard
- Plan capacity, performance and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations

Your profile Must-haves: 
- Kubernetes in production – built, not just used : you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm , RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role 
- Lived SRE practice : SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call 
- Hands-on experience with GitOps or comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus 
- Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust 
- A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround 
- A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution 
Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): 
- Harvester, KubeVirt , vSphere/ ESXi , OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms 
- Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN) 
- Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler ) and capacity/cost planning 
- Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs 
- German language skills 
Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. 

You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords.

THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US - Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe.
- Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right.
- AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword.
- Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role.
- Flexible work: Hybrid work model three office days per week with a focus on outcomes.
- Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline.

Job Location Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm (all Hybrid)

title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
description:
What we do At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.

What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end 

- Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
- Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
- Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
- Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
Turn the data into something users act on 

- Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
- Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
- Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway
Own the numbers 

- Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
- Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
- Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you

What we are looking for You might be a fit if: 

- You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
- You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
- You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
- You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
- Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
- You're fluent in English; German is a plus
- You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany
That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have: 

- PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
- Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
- Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
- Subscription and paywall experimentation
- Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
- Your own portfolio, and opinions about it
If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation 

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like 

- Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
- Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
- Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
- Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you
You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.

Why join getquin? Why join getquin? 

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

- Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand and optimize your wealth
- The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
- You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours
Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire 

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

- Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
- Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
- Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
- Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
- Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder
Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
description:
Aufgaben  Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? 

Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus!
Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.
Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. 

Deine Aufgaben 

- Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps. 
- Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic -basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter. 
- Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich. 
- Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents – zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures. 
- Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign . 
- Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment -Prozesse mit. 
- Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen. 
- Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden. 
- Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen. 
Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: 

- PHP und Laravel 
- Statamic 
- PostgreSQL 
- Livewire 
- HTML, CSS und JavaScript 
- RESTful APIs 
- Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment -Prozessen 
- Large Language Models und Coding Agents 
Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. 
Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.

Qualifikation - Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher. 
- Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken. 
- Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich in Laravel , Statamic , PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln. 
- Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und Coding Agents sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen. 
- Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern, Deployment und grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten. 
- Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen. 
- Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten. 
- Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen. 
- Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert. 
- Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen. 
- Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen. 
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich. 
Was uns wichtig ist 

Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren.
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.

Benefits Wir bieten dir: 

- Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen 
- Die Möglichkeit, unseren Tech-Stack aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln 
- Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege 
- Einen vielseitigen Job mit direktem Einfluss auf unser Business und unsere Produkte 
- Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Teilzeit oder Vollzeit 
- 28 Tage Urlaub 
- Flexibilität bei Arbeitszeit und Arbeitsort > Drei Tage pro Woche in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte, zwei Tage im MobileOffice 
- Persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer echten Wachstumskultur 
- Eine offene, freundliche Atmosphäre mit Partnerinnen, Partnern und Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt 

Deine Bewerbung 

Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, persönliches Motivationsschreiben mit maximal 1.000 Zeichen: Warum möchtest du als Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d) bei Table.Briefings arbeiten? 

Uns interessiert besonders, welche Probleme du gerne löst, wie du mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungen umgehst und was dich daran reizt, Technologie mit konkretem unternehmerischem und redaktionellem Nutzen zu entwickeln.

title: Data Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
We're looking for a Data Platform Engineer (m/f/d) to join our team and help build and operate the data infrastructure that powers Flix's mobility platform.

At FlixTech, our data platform enables teams across the company to process, analyze, and act on large volumes of mobility data. The platform supports critical use cases such as network planning, pricing, operations, and business analytics. You will work on scalable infrastructure that processes millions of daily events and ensures reliable data availability across the organization.

You'll be part of a cross-functional engineering environment collaborating with data analysts, data scientists, and platform engineers. The role focuses on building reliable, scalable data systems and enabling other teams to work efficiently with data.

About the Role 

- Design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure running on AWS and Kubernetes

- Develop and operate streaming and data platform components using technologies such as Kafka and Snowflake

- Implement monitoring, alerting, and operational tooling to ensure platform reliability and performance

- Own features end-to-end, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance

- Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and GitLab CI/CD

- Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to support data platform use cases

- Contribute to improving platform reliability, automation, and engineering practices

- Participate in on-call rotations to support the stability of the data platform

About You 

- 3+ years of experience building or operating data infrastructure or data platforms

- Hands-on experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka and data warehouses like Snowflake

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab)

- Practical experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and container platforms such as Kubernetes

- Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Datadog or similar)

- Solid programming skills in Python and interest in writing clean, maintainable code

- Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with technical and business stakeholders

- Fluent in English

Nice to have:

- Experience with advanced SQL or data transformation tools (e.g., dbt)

title: Commercial Account Executive, DACH
description:
Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact. 

At Algolia, we are passionate about helping businesses connect their end-users with what matters most in milliseconds!

As an Algolia Account Executive, you will be responsible for creating strong relationships with our customers/prospects and building on these relationships to expand our footprint or close new businesses. You should be comfortable researching prospective customers and adapting sales strategies to meet their needs. You will also play an integral role in defining our sales model. You know the ins and outs of Algolia, understand how we can benefit each prospect and will ultimately be the front line of our revenue growth in the German-speaking and CEMEA markets.

Algolia has been growing exponentially over the past few years with Germany representing one of our core markets. We are now expanding our existing German-speaking team to further accelerate in this region, providing you with the opportunity to become one of the core players in our success story. You will be an important voice in how we address this market and able to gain a lot of visibility both within our fast-growing tech company as well as within the German eCommerce/ retail segment.

Are you a resilient problem-solver who isn't afraid to think outside the box and get their hands dirty? We expect you to take ownership and be able to execute, defining your own territory strategy. We're looking for candidates who raise the level and bring sales excellence to the revenue organisation. You should value and practice transparency, have the humility to accept your weaknesses and continuously strive to improve both personally and professionally.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF: 

- Managing and growing a sales pipeline

- Driving inbound and outbound leads through complex sales cycles to closed won

- Working your network and collaborating with external partners to source and facilitate new projects in the Commercial segment

- Managing and prospecting with an existing account base to drive usage-based and feature-based upsells

- Generating new projects from booking self-driven outbound meetings

- Building compelling demonstrations with the pre-sales team, sales material and ROI studies bringing value to our customers

- Forecasting accurately to help the team hit their numbers

- Collaborating with sales developers, solutions engineers, customer success managers, legal, partner managers and marketing.

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE: 

- 2 - 4 years of experience in a closing role (esp. in B2B, MarTech, SaaS tech sales)

- Excellent spoken and written German and English skills, Polish or Czech a plus

- Hunter mindset: Strong familiarity with outbound prospecting techniques, tools and processes

- Strong Plus: Experience in working with partners (solution integrators, consultancies, independent software vendors)

- Multi-tasker who can adapt to changing situations

- Quick thinker, must be able to handle questions on the fly

NICE TO HAVE: 

- You love tech sales;

- You have a curious mindset and are capable to understand prospects’ pains and how a deep tech solution like Algolia can solve it;

- You thrive in dynamic environments and are capable to adjust to constant change;

- You are excited by the idea of building things and have a structured and strategic approach to working your territory;

- You believe you are in charge of your own success and you have the grit to continue going when things get challenging.

#LI-Hybrid 

Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

On-Target Earnings Pay Range

€120.000 — €160.000 EUR 

FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY: 

Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when. 

We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule. 

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES: 

- GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.

- TRUST - Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.

- CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.

- CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.

- HUMILITY - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.

We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.

IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice 

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:

- Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the best way to apply safely is directly through our careers page .

- All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an ----- email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an ----- email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.

- We’ll never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details during the hiring process.

READY TO APPLY? 

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
Why Verifone 

For more than 40 years Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone has one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and is one of the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in the fact that we work with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third party partners to invent and deliver innovative payments solution around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services, and are obsessed with customer happiness. Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives each one of our employees for personal and professional success.

Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy.

What's Exciting About The Role 

To ensure the long-term stability and growth of strategically important international customer relationships, we are hiring a Senior Key Account Manager . Reporting to and working closely with the current Global Account Manager, you will support the operational and strategic management of key accounts, ensuring continuity of customer relationships while developing the expertise required to assume full account responsibility over time.

This role sits within our DACH sales organization led by our Head of DACH, which is responsible for our SMB, Enterprise, Partner, and eCommerce/ mCommerce segments across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Full backup coverage and involvement in the Key Account Manager's day-to-day business 

- Building in-depth accounts knowledge (contractual status, contacts, commercial history, open topics) to ensure a seamless handover 

- Maintaining the customer relationships with key contacts at the international companies on an operational and tactical level 

- Coordinating internal interfaces (Product, Compliance, legal, Onboarding, Helpdesk, IT) to ensure smooth service delivery 

- Contributing to forecasting, pipeline maintenance in Salesforce, and account reporting 

- Preparing for and participating in business reviews and escalation calls 

- Supporting contract negotiations and commercial proposals in coordination with the Global Account Manager 

Skills and Experience We Desire 

- Fluency in both German and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in both languages

- Extensive experience within the payments industry, with strong expertise in payment gateways, acquiring services, and payment terminal solutions.

- Proven track record in Key Account Management or Relationship Management, ideally within the payments, financial services, or retail sectors.

- Experience managing complex international customer organizations, including global and multi-market enterprise accounts.

- Proficiency in Salesforce and/or comparable CRM platforms, with a disciplined approach to account and pipeline management.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior decision-makers.

- Highly organized and self-motivated, with a structured working style, strong attention to detail, and the reliability to ensure seamless customer support and business continuity when acting as a backup.

Key Success Criteria 

- Develop a strong understanding of the assigned key accounts and actively manage them in close partnership with the Global Account Manager.

- Achieve full backup capability for the assigned accounts by the end of the onboarding period, ensuring seamless customer support and continuity.

- Establish and maintain effective working relationships with all relevant internal stakeholders across Verifone supporting the customer portfolio.

- Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders across commercial, operational, and executive levels.

- Consistently deliver a high standard of customer service, reflected in positive feedback from customer contacts and stakeholders.

- Contribute actively to revenue growth opportunities through accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning.

- Demonstrate increasing ownership of account activities and readiness to assume broader account responsibilities over time.

Our Commitment 

Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

title: Product Designer | SimpleStudy
description:
Role: Senior Product Designer

Company: SimpleStudy 

Location: Remote, Europe (preferably Western / continental); relocation to Lisbon possible

Job Type: Full-time

About SimpleStudy

SimpleStudy is an AI exam prep platform that students find and choose for themselves.

In some numbers:

- 1.5M+ students across the UK, Ireland, Brazil, South Africa, and Australia

- 40–50k new students every week

- Web, mobile, and desktop apps

- $4M seed round with investors from Strava, OpenAI, and Meta

The traction came fast. Now the company is refounding: rebuilding the brand, the design language, and the product experience from scratch. The product grew like a Jenga tower, one feature on top of another. The job now is to rebuild it as a pyramid.

The team is ~30 people, remote with a Lisbon office — lean, product-led, and deliberately not a typical edtech company.

You'll report to José, the Founding Designer, and work with him as a partner. José tends to lead early framing and direction. You bring strong craft and take the work to the finish line, in close sync with engineering. You both shape the new design language, and you push back with a better idea when you see one.

What you are expected to do:

- Shape the new design language and brand: design system, rebrand, and the new mobile app.

- Own the full design process — from an ambiguous problem to a polished, shipped solution.

- Drive the consumer experience: onboarding, social features, retention, and the learning loop.

- Work in close sync with engineers and PM, not as a handoff step - polish the implementation together until it feels right.

- Bring your own initiatives and say "no, but…" when you see a better way.

- Raise the bar for the whole design team.

What you need to succeed:

- High craft — your visual work is polished and intentional; the details reveal your thinking.

- Storytelling over process — you take an ambiguous problem, frame it, and make it simple. Your portfolio shows artifacts, not diagrams; it has a point of view.

- Consumer instinct — you've shipped B2C products that people chose to use. You understand product metrics and use them as input, but you lead with feel and craft.

- Opinions with backbone — you have a design philosophy, can defend it under pushback, and bring your own initiatives. You don't wait to be told what to build.

- Energy and curiosity — you're an interesting person with a life outside work, and you leave people energised after a conversation.

- English — fluent, written and spoken.

What would be a plus:

- A standout specialty: prototyping, illustration, animation, or motion.

- Experience with social or viral product mechanics.

- Background at consumer companies like Spotify or Strava.

- Early-stage or founding designer experience.

- Comfortable in code: prototyping or polishing the front end.

What you get:

- Build from scratch, at scale — a new design language for a product already used by 1.5M+ students.

- A strong partner - work closely with José, the Founding Designer (ex-Shopify), with direct access to the founders.

- Equity — generous stock options, early enough for them to matter.

- Remote Europe — work from where you choose, with in-person meetups three times a year; relocation support if you want to move to Lisbon.

- Competitive salary — no fixed budget, flexible.

How to apply: 

A deck or a walkthrough video is fine. Show the work, keep it curated. 

Please email links to your LinkedIn / Resume and portfolio to 

The vacancy is proudly presented by the hirehire recruiting agency.

"Craft matters here from day one. You'll rebuild the brand, the design system and the product together with José, a founding designer who cares a lot about how things feel. 1.5M students, real traction, and a team that picks quality over speed." 

— Tanya Sivo
Product Design Expert, hirehire

Zahlen sind für dich kein Selbstzweck, sondern die Grundlage guter Entscheidungen? Du willst kein kleines Rädchen in einer großen Finanzabteilung sein, sondern echte Verantwortung und tiefe Einblicke in die Abläufe eines FinTechs? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Als (Junior) Finance Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest du in einem schlagkräftigen, kleinen Finance Team direkt mit dem VP Finance zusammen – und übernimmst von Tag eins an Verantwortung. Von der laufenden Buchhaltung über Monats- und Jahresabschluss bis zu Reporting, Forecasts und der Automatisierung unserer Prozesse deckst du die gesamte Bandbreite ab – und siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit bei Management, Investoren und Board ankommt. So entwickelst du ein tiefes Verständnis der finanziellen Steuerung eines der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter Europas – und prägst sie aktiv mit.

Was machst du dabei konkret? 

- Monatsabschluss: Du übernimmst eigenständig wiederkehrende Reporting- und Abschlussaufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass unser Monatsabschluss steht – pünktlich und verlässlich

- Jahresabschluss: Du bringst dich in die Vorbereitung des HGB Jahresabschlusses ein und unterstützt unsere Accountants und Wirtschaftsprüfer beim Audit.

- Reporting: Du erstellst KPIs und Finanzkennzahlen für Management-Präsentationen und wirkst an Investoren- und Board-Unterlagen mit.

- Analysen: Du baust Finanzmodelle, Forecasts und Abweichungsanalysen und machst aus Zahlen belastbare Insights.

- Prozessautomatisierung: Du digitalisierst und automatisierst unsere Finanzprozesse u.a. über AI Anwendungen – und findest die Tools, die uns morgen schneller machen.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT 

- Erfahrung & Qualifikation: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und/oder ein Studium. Erste praktische Erfahrung im Accounting/Controlling, Consulting, Investment Banking oder Venture Capital ist ein Vorteil.

- Analytische Fähigkeiten: Zahlen sind dein Zuhause: Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest sicher in Excel und findest dich schnell in Tools wie NetSuite, Abacum, Moss oder PowerPoint zurecht. Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und AI Tools ist ein Plus – vieles davon lernst du bei uns on the Job.

- Mindset: Du bringst eine proaktive, sorgfältige und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise mit und blühst in einem dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Startup Umfeld auf. Du bist ambitioniert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und ziehst Dinge eigenständig durch.

- Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1) und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Arbeitskontext wohl. 

So geht es für dich weiter 

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

- Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit Larissa: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob Deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

- Interview mit Jessie : Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten ein und lernen uns noch besser kennen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Fragen zu stellen und mehr über das Internship zu erfahren.

- Case Study Runde: Gemeinsam mit Jan und einem weiteren Senior Teammitglied wird auf eine typische Situation eingegangen, die Dir in dieser Rolle begegnen könnte. So bekommst Du den bestmöglichen Einblick in den praktischen Alltag.

- Kennelernen vor Ort: Besuche unser Berliner Büro, lerne die Menschen persönlich kennen, mit denen du eng zusammenarbeiten wirst, und bekomme ein echtes Gefühl für unsere Kultur, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere gemeinsamen Ziele.

Über uns 

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

title: Executive Business Partner (m/w/d)
description:
About us

We're on a mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. We close critical skill gaps in the workforce, in AI, data, engineering and more, through applied, guided and equitable learning programmes with measurable impact. Multiverse works with over 1,500 leading companies globally to solve business-critical skills challenges. We launched in Germany this year via our acquisition of StackFuel and our ambition is big: upskill 100,000 learners as soon as possible.

The role

Multiverse Germany's MD Office is looking for a proactive, tech-forward and experienced Executive Business Partner (m/w/d) to support the Managing Director (MD) and Chief of Staff (CoS), to help run a fast-growing Berlin office. Executive and business operations support is the core of this role: your responsibility will lie in managing the diary of the MD and other senior leaders, helping to drive our overall business operations and company rhythm. With competing priorities inevitably arising, this role will require you to use your judgment to prevent unnecessary involvement of the MD in day-to-day situations or proactively involve him or the CoS when urgent. You'll also work closely with the UK team to keep Multiverse Germany aligned with company-wide rhythms.

In addition to that, you’ll have the option to help build a high-performance, high-agency culture (e.g., owning the internal event calendar and other initiatives) in the Berlin office. In doing all of the above, automation with AI runs through all of what you’ll do. Wherever a process is repeatable, you're expected and excited to use AI tools to speed things up.

Key responsibilities: 

- Support the MD primarily and provide additional support to other senior leaders , as directed, to ensure that company goals and objectives are accomplished and that operations run efficiently

- Maintain and refine internal processes that support the MD, leadership team and the company

- Manage professional and personal scheduling for the MD , including calendar management, preparing agendas, drafting emails, preparing phone calls or customer meeting briefings

- Manage the MDs and senior executives’ travel logistics and activities , including accommodations, transportation, and meals

- Assist and manage all logistics from end-to-end of small to larger scale events, for example, company All-Hands, leadership offsites or one-off customer events

- Coordinate closely with the UK and build relationships with UK-based Executive Business Partners, Business Operations Managers and teams so Germany stays aligned with company-wide meeting rhythms and conventions

- Automate where you can and use AI tools to cut manual admin across scheduling, reporting and follow-up

Who you are: 

- You are comfortable in a constantly evolving environment: you can operate in a highly changing, fast-paced environment and prepare decisions, even when things are ambiguous and you can hold multiple threads at the same time

- You are a strong communicator: you know when to raise a challenge, but even more so, you solve operational challenges them proactively before they reach the CoS or MD

- You've done this before: several years as an EA, business or operations coordinator, or similar, ideally supporting leaders in a fast-paced or scaling environment

- You think like an operator: you don't just execute tasks, you build the process, tracker or system behind them: every challenge is a problem about to be solved

- You default to automation: you look to cut repeatable admin with AI tools rather than doing it by hand

- You're discreet and trusted: you handle sensitive information with sound judgement

- You're native or fluent in German, with strong conversational English: this is needed to coordinate closely with the UK team
