title: Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT 

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT 

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades : Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload.

This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work.

You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage.

The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows.

- Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products.

- Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows.

- Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases.

- Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration.

- Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions.

- Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop.

- Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention.

- Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart.

- Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows.

- Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments.

Must-Have Skills 

- 7+ years of product management experience , including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end.

- Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering.

- Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas , from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration.

- Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products , including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring.

- Strong customer discovery and product judgment , with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities.

- Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment , with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity.

- Proven cross-functional ownership , working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams.

- English at C1 level and German at C2 level. 

- Willingness to stay close to customers and the team , including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent).

Nice-to-Have Skills 

- Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI , particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows.

- Experience with AI monetisation , including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models.

- Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades .

- Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits .

- Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish .

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR 

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit. 

You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new.

You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions.

You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to.

And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable.

WHY PLANCRAFT? 

- Team Spirit : We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

- Ownership : You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

- Learning & Growth : We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

- AI Enablement : Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

- Tech & Tooling : You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

- Flexibility : Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

- Recharge : To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

- Mobility : You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

- International Environment : We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page .

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here . If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account: 
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) – AI-Native Development
description:
Was wir tun

Als IoT Pioniere entwickeln wir mit mittlerweile über 40 Kollegen*innen an drei Standorten IoT-Komplettlösungen für unsere Kunden. 
Aktuell sind weltweit über 500.000 Geräte und Anlagen mit unseren Lösungen für Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation ausgestattet.

Unsere Kompetenz liegt in der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer IoT-Lösungen, basierend auf unserer Erfahrung, unseren erprobten Software-Bausteinen und einer Vielzahl von bereits realisierten Projekten.

Unser Team

Seit der Firmengründung im Jahr 2004 sind wir stetig gewachsen und haben uns in diesem Markt über die Jahre als starker Partner etabliert. 
Damit das auch so bleibt, erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Team mit talentierten und qualifizierten Entwickler*innen.
Durch vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Workshops sowie eine ausgeprägte Feedback-Kultur heben wir unser Team auf die nächste Stufe.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine(n) Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) an den Standorten GARBSEN (bei Hannover), BISSENDORF (bei Osnabrück) oder Berlin 

Deine Aufgaben

Du willst nicht nur Features abarbeiten, sondern Anwendungen als Ganzes verstehen, gestalten und weiterentwickeln?

Bei der INSIDE M2M GmbH entwickelst du anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen für unsere IoT-Plattform. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt in Angular und TypeScript – und du entwickelst den Fluss durchgängig über Backend-Services mit Java und Quarkus – bis hin zu den Devices.

KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Handwerk, nicht zum Hype. Du setzt sie souverän ein, bewertest ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und verantwortest Qualität, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit deines Codes.

- Du entwickelst komplexe Angular-Anwendungen mit sauberer Komponentenarchitektur – von der Konzeption bis zur produktiven Nutzung.

- Du arbeitest an den dazugehörigen Backend-Services in Java und Quarkus und gestaltest die Schnittstellen zwischen Frontend und Plattform mit.

- Du integrierst KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents fest in deinen Workflow.

- Du bringst dich in Architekturentscheidungen, Code Reviews und die Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein.

- Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team, unseren Kunden und weiteren technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.

Das bringst du mit

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
description:
Als VC-backed Foodtech-Startup schaffen wir den Spagat zwischen gesunder Ernährung, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Mit unseren Foodjis bringen wir ultrafrische, leckere Gerichte genau dorthin, wo du die meiste Zeit verbringst – denn wir haben uns zum Ziel gesetzt, über 10 Millionen Arbeitnehmern endlich Zugang zu gesunder Ernährung zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig Foodwaste zu reduzieren. 

Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis 

Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften. 

Deine Mission bei Foodji: 

- (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime. 

- Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen. 

- Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter. 

- Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen. 

- Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten. 

- Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs. 

DAS BRINGST DU MIT 

- Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg. 

- Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren. 

- Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse. 

- Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen. 

- Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse. 

- Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen. 

- Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. 

NOCH FRAGEN? 

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! 

DAS BIETEN WIR 

- Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote 

- Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze 

- bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente 

- Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung 

- EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios 

- JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec 

- KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind 

- Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands 

- Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen 

- Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive 

- Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland 

- Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür 

- Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! 

ÜBER UNS 

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. 

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. 

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. 

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. 

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description:
What we do At Briink , we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:
- Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
- Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
- Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)

Your role As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer , you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:
- Own product features end to end , from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
- Design and build scalable backend systems , including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
- Build and ship applied AI/LLM features , such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
- Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
- Improve the robustness of our systems , strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
- Work directly with users, product, and data , using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
- Prototype and test new AI capabilities , turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
- Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge , helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
- Collaborate closely with other engineers , including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.

Your profile Technical requirements - Strong professional backend engineering experience , with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
- Experience in a small, high-ownership product team , ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
- Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end , rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
- Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
- Strong API, database, and systems design skills , with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
- Applied AI/LLM experience : you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
- A solid software-quality mindset , including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
- Cloud and container experience , with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
- Fluent English (C1+) , both written and spoken. 
Nice to have - Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products .
- Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
- Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks 
- Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems .
- Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
- Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting .
- German language skills.
Who you are - Kind and collaborative : You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
- Mission-driven : You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
- Sharp and curious : You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
- A product-minded builder : You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
- Highly self-directed : You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
- Pragmatic and action-oriented : You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
- Opinionated but open-minded : You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
- Commercially aware and creative : You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed.
If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection!

What we offer - Competitive salary and equity , reflecting your impact and ownership.
- Purpose-driven mission : Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent.
- Flexible hybrid setup : Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus.
- Trust and autonomy : Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows.
- A genuinely high-impact role : Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation.
- Dynamic environment : Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability.
- Learning budget and quarterly hackathons : Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward.
- A thoughtful hiring process : We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so.

title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager (all genders)

Jetzt geht es um die zweite Stufe: aus einzelnen Kanälen ein System machen, das trägt, und aus marta eine Marke, die Familien kennen, bevor sie zum ersten Mal suchen.

Darauf arbeiten wir gemeinsam hin: die erste große Marke für Altenpflege in Europa. Die gibt es bisher nicht.

Wir suchen die Person, die das plant, koordiniert und schreibt. Du denkst dir Kampagnen aus und bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material. Du entscheidest mit, welchen Kanal wir als Nächstes aufmachen und in welcher Reihenfolge. Und du sprichst mit denen, die das möglich machen: Sendern, Veranstaltern, Partnern, Produktionen.

Wenn du es leid bist, deine beste Idee in einer Präsentation sterben zu sehen, ist das hier der Unterschied: keine Pitch-Runden, keine Freigabekette, keine dritte Feedbackschleife. Du stellst deine Idee dem Performance-Marketing und den Gründern vor, und ihr entscheidet im selben Gespräch. Was montags beschlossen wird, läuft spätestens in der Woche darauf.

Wir sind eine der größten Plattformen im deutschen 24-Stunden-Pflegemarkt, finanziert von führenden Investoren wie Capnamic, Almaz Capital, RTL Ventures und Swiss Health Ventures, mit einem bundesweiten Franchise-System und Teams in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig.

Level: Senior. Du planst und koordinierst: Kanäle, Budget, Timing, Briefings. Die Texte schreibst du selbst.

An deiner Seite: unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager. Dort liegen Analyse, Attribution und die Aussteuerung der bezahlten Kanäle. Bei dir liegen Marke, Kampagnen und die Kanäle daneben. Ihr arbeitet auf Augenhöhe an einem Funnel.

Founder-Nähe: du arbeitest eng und direkt mit den Gründern an Marke, Botschaft und Ideen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.

Perspektive: Head of Brand mit eigenem Team. Die Bedingung dafür sagen wir dir offen: mindestens ein zusätzlicher skalierbarer Push-Kanal, der uns spürbar schneller wachsen lässt.

Start: so bald wie möglich

Deine Rolle in unserem Team Du bist die erste Person bei marta, die ausschließlich für die Marke da ist. 8 von 10 unserer treuesten Familien würden marta weiterempfehlen. Diese Geschichte erzählt bisher niemand systematisch. Du gibst marta eine Stimme, ein Gesicht und Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Was du jetzt festlegst, ist das Fundament für alles, was danach kommt.

Was du machst - Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben . Du entwickelst Kampagnen für Familien, die vor einer der schwersten Entscheidungen ihres Lebens stehen. Keine Werbeanzeigen, sondern etwas, das man sich merkt. Und du bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material.
- Kanäle planen und koordinieren . Du entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes testen, in welcher Reihenfolge und mit welchem Erfolgskriterium. Und du sagst genauso klar, was wir uns sparen, weil du Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Kanälen mitbringst.
- Texte, die du selbst schreibst. Landingpages, SEO- und Ratgeber-Content, Anzeigentexte, E-Mails, Videoskripte, Social, Print. Am Anfang entstehen sie an deinem Schreibtisch, zunehmend KI-gestützt. Wenn ein Kanal skaliert und wir echtes Volumen brauchen, holen wir Unterstützung dazu. 
- Produktion briefen . Für Film, Design und größere Produktionen arbeitest du mit Freelancern und Spezialisten. Du briefst sie, beurteilst, was zurückkommt, und hältst die Marke über alle Kanäle konsistent.
- Social Media, UGC und Community . Hinter marta steht eine große Community aus Betreuungskräften. Daraus machst du Formate, Geschichten und nutzergenerierte Inhalte. Unser Ziel: der größte Pflegekanal Deutschlands. 
- PR und Presse . Du arbeitest mit einer PR-Agentur, schreibst Pressemitteilungen und baust Regionalpresse als Kanal auf.
- CRM und Lifecycle . Die Entscheidung für eine 24-Stunden-Betreuung zieht sich über Wochen. Willkommensstrecken, Reaktivierung, WhatsApp: die richtige Botschaft zum richtigen Zeitpunkt statt nur Bottom of Funnel. Die Strecken füllst du mit dem richtigen Content und hast ein Auge dafür was funktioniert und was nicht.
- Botschaft und Tonalität . Du übersetzt unsere fünf Personas in konkrete Botschaften und Touchpoints. Familien entscheiden emotional und nach Qualität, nicht nach Preis. Dein Text muss das treffen.

Dazu kommen die Themen, die du als Erstes in die Hand nimmst: Bewertungen und Google Business Profile, eine Mechanik für Empfehlungen, Regionalpresse und die Sichtbarkeit von marta in der KI-Suche.

So sieht Erfolg aus 
Nach 90 Tagen: die erste CRM-Strecke ist live, zwei Kanäle sind erfolgreich angetestet, die ersten Ergebnisse sind vielversprechend, und wir gehen in die Skalierung.
Nach 6 Monaten: die Markenbotschaft steht und ist an allen Kontaktpunkten sichtbar, zwei bis drei eigene Kampagnen sind live, und das Performance-Marketing arbeitet mit frischem Material statt mit denselben drei Anzeigen.
Nach 12 Monaten: marta hat eine Kampagne, die Familien wiedererkennen, der YouTube-Kanal wächst und liefert Material, das in anderen Kanälen weiterläuft, Branded und Direct Traffic steigen, und neue Quellen liefern verlässlich mehr als 3.000 zusätzliche Leads pro Monat..

description:
About Keyfactor 

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor! 

Title: Student QA Engineer (Working Student)

Department: Engineering / Quality Assurance

Location: Aachen, Germany

Working Hours: Up to 19 hours per week

Employment Type: Student Employment

Position Overview 

Keyfactor – PrimeKey Labs is seeking a Student QA Engineer to support the Engineering and Quality Assurance teams in ensuring the quality, reliability and correctness of our security and PKI-based products. The primary focus of this role is on test case design, manual test execution and product understanding, with the opportunity to explore test automation as familiarity with the systems and workflows increases.

Key Responsibilities 

- Review and understand product features, technical requirements and user workflows.

- Design, document and maintain structured and traceable test cases.

- Perform manual test execution and record results, defects and observations.

- Collaborate with development and product teams to clarify expected behavior and acceptance criteria.

- Identify and document test cases suitable for future automation.

- Support the development and maintenance of automated tests using TypeScript and related tools as applicable.

- Maintain QA documentation, test reports and related internal artifacts.

- Assist with hardware interaction and test environment setup and validation.

- Support OAB (Operational and Automation Backend) maintenance and related quality assurance activities.

- Participate in testing and validation of PKI and security-related workflows.

Required Qualifications 

- Currently enrolled in a degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT Security or a related field.

- Understanding of basic software testing principles and quality assurance processes.

- Strong attention to detail and a structured working approach.

- Ability to document work clearly and consistently.

- Willingness to work across testing, documentation and technical support tasks as required by product needs.

- Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

- Flexibility is supported in coordination with team and academic commitments. #LI-NA1 

Preferred Qualifications 

- Familiarity with any programming or scripting language, TypeScript is an advantage.

- Interest in cybersecurity, PKI or cryptographic systems.

- Basic experience with test management or defect tracking tools.

- Basic knowledge of automation tools or CI systems such as Jenkins.

Working Model 

- Up to 19 hours per week during the academic term.

- Primary in-office days are Wednesday and Thursday at the Aachen location.

- Flexibility is supported in coordination with team and academic commitments.

Compensation 

Salary will be commensurate with experience.  

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits 

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas.  

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:   

- Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.

- Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.

- Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support. 

- Competitive time off globally.

- Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees. 

- DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology. 

- The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts. 

- Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays. 

- Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.

- Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development. 

- Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings. 

Our Core Values 

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.    

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.   

Customers are core.    

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.   

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.

title: Director, Mobility Partnerships
description:
Material Bank is the world's largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.

As Director, Mobility Partnerships, you will lead Material Bank's expansion into the global mobility interiors market, building strategic partnerships with leading brands across automotive, aviation, and marine. This is not a traditional sales role—it is an opportunity to establish a new vertical by leveraging deep industry expertise, trusted relationships, and commercial acumen.

You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and securing founding brand partners while serving as Material Bank's representative within a highly specialized industry. Success in this role requires credibility, confidence, and the ability to build long-term relationships with senior leaders across Europe and North America. You understand the business, speak the language of the industry, and know how to create value beyond the transaction.

This is a senior, external-facing role for someone who has spent their career within the mobility interiors ecosystem. You thrive in face-to-face conversations, industry events, customer visits, and executive meetings, knowing that lasting partnerships are built through trust and personal relationships. The role is Europe-based and requires extensive international travel (approximately 80–90%) across Europe and North America, with significant focus on Germany, Switzerland, and the Netherlands.

What you'll do 

- Build Material Bank's founding portfolio of mobility interior brand partners across automotive, aviation, and marine.

- Own the full business development lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and developing relationships through negotiation and partnership execution.

- Represent Material Bank at industry trade shows, conferences, and customer events, building awareness and establishing credibility within the mobility interiors community.

- Develop trusted relationships with executives, commercial leaders, designers, specification teams, and decision-makers across leading manufacturers and suppliers.

- Lead consultative business conversations that demonstrate how Material Bank creates value through material discovery, digital sampling, specification tools, and market insights.

- Partner closely with Product, Catalog, Marketing, and Leadership to shape Material Bank's strategy for the mobility sector, bringing customer and market insights back into the business.

- Identify market opportunities, competitive trends, and emerging technologies that influence the future of mobility interiors.

- Serve as a trusted industry expert, helping establish Material Bank as the leading platform for mobility material discovery.

What you'll bring 

- 15+ years of experience within the mobility interiors industry, ideally in automotive, aviation, marine, or a related materials manufacturing environment.

- Deep knowledge of the European mobility market, with an established network of manufacturers, suppliers, OEMs, and industry leaders.

- A proven ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior executives through credibility, expertise, and a consultative approach.

- Strong commercial instincts with experience developing new business and closing strategic partnerships.

- An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build a business, create opportunities, and operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy.

- Exceptional communication skills and executive presence, with confidence engaging customers, partners, and industry leaders.

- Experience representing organizations at industry events and trade shows.

- Highly self-motivated, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

- Willingness to travel extensively (approximately 75%) throughout Europe and North America.

- A passion for innovation and the future of mobility design.

Material Bank connects design professionals to hundreds of manufacturers through facilitating brand discovery, sales rep engagement, and material sampling. Our powerful material database and proprietary robotic distribution facility allow members to order samples to be delivered free of charge overnight.Material Bank was founded by Adam Sandow in 2018 and has deeply transformed how the Architecture and Design industry works in the United States. It's an exciting time for the company - Material Bank is growing rapidly and expanding the business to Europe with regional headquarters based in Paris, and offices in London and Stuttgart . Candidates who join us will have the unique opportunity to define, build, and shape our European business.

Material Bank uses your information to process your current application and offer you job opportunities in the future. You have the right to access, rectify, and erase this information, as well as to limit its use or object to it and give directives on its fate after your death. For more information, please consult our privacy policy: https://www.materialbank.eu/privacy-policy

- Our people : We are a growth-driven team that values efficiency, builds smart automation, operates in small empowered teams, and moves quickly from idea to execution. 

- Relaxation and Celebrations : Flexible PTO, Sick Days, Paid National Holidays, and even more (ask us about this when we connect). 

- Health Benefits : We contribute to your medical, dental, vision and short-term/long-term disability plans and have a strong employee assistance program. 

- Plan for your Retirement : 401(k) eligible after your first 90 day's employed! 

- Giving Back : We sponsor multiple events throughout the year to help out our communities. 

- Growth : We'll help you take your career to the next level. We want you to be creative and take initiative which will allow you to grow and create within the company. Most importantly, be the best at what matters! 

- Flexible Work Schedules : With business units and employees across the globe, Material Technologies has embraced a  hybrid  working  model allowing department leaders to decide on the best approach for their respective teams, whether that be remote, in person, or a little of both.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. - Domain expertise must include value/procurement engineering or TCO-related work at the component & product level

- Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role 

As a Research Scientist - AI Safety at Faculty, you will conduct original technical research in AI safety to build the foundation for safe, trustworthy AI deployment. Operating at the forefront of AI, you will design and execute impactful experiments, study model behaviour, and develop robust, reproducible tooling. Working alongside Senior and Lead Research Scientists, you will bridge scientific discovery with practical application, helping translate complex technical insights for external partners, frontier labs, and national security institutes. This is an incredible opportunity to hone your expertise, shape emerging safety standards, and solve some of the most critical challenges in modern AI.

What you'll be doing: 

- Executing technical research in AI safety by designing and running experiments to study and steer model behaviour.

- Applying white-box and black-box methodologies, focusing on interpretability, steering, and behavioural studies of transformer-based LLMs.

- Developing high-quality, modular, and reproducible research code in Python using deep learning frameworks like PyTorch.

- Building and maintaining research infrastructure and technical tooling to accelerate scientific discovery.

- Documenting and communicating experimental findings through high-quality academic papers, technical reports, and presentations.

- Collaborating with senior scientists to identify literature gaps, refine hypotheses, and identify research scope.

- Translating complex technical insights for diverse audiences, including external frontier labs, government bodies, and safety institutes.

Who we're looking for: 

- Solid background in machine learning fundamentals and transformer architectures (specifically LLMs).

- A practical understanding of white-box and black-box interpretability techniques, such as steering vectors or mechanistic interpretability.

- Demonstrated capability to take structured technical problems and formulate hypotheses

- Strong programming skills in Python and deep learning frameworks like PyTorch, with a track record of writing clean, modular research code, using Git for version control.

- Excellent communication , enabling you to translate complex technical concepts and experimental results into clear reports and presentations.

- Curiosity and analytical rigour , combined with exposure to core AI safety areas such as robustness, evaluations, or uncertainty calibration.

Our Recruitment Ethos 

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Manager/Associate Director - Project Management
description:
About Relation 

Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.

We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.

By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

The opportunity 

Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to work in close partnership with our Programme and Project Leaders, putting you in a prime position to help shape delivery plans and drive our osteoporosis programme forward.

Working across the full discovery journey, you'll help move the programme through Target ID, Hit-to-Lead, Lead Optimisation, Candidate Selection and beyond — coordinating across the multiple projects that make up the programme, our internal interdisciplinary teams, and third-party partners such as CROs, all while navigating the ambiguity of discovery-stage science with confidence.

You'll operate at programme level, with visibility across every project within the osteoporosis programme, partnering with the Programme Leader and the Project Leaders who own each individual project. If this sounds like you, and you thrive in matrixed environments and want a real hand in shaping how tomorrow's medicines are discovered, come and join us in the heart of London.

Day to day, you will 

- Partner with Programme, Project Leaders and sponsors to understand the strategic objectives and delivery requirements across the programme.

- Orchestrate the matrix team to deliver against project objectives, motivating all team members with clear direction and communication.

- Work with functional leads to ensure appropriate resource allocation and to onboard supplementary resources where needed to support delivery.

- Proactively manage plans, budgets, risks and issues across the programme, escalating to senior management when appropriate.

- Support leadership in navigating high-impact, high-risk situations with clear analysis, high transparency and a spirit of partnership — even in the face of significant adversity or major obstacles.

- Translate scientific and strategic objectives into integrated project plans, timelines and milestones.

- Coordinate execution across the wet lab, ML research, data science and engineering teams, owning cross-team dependencies and prioritisation, and actively monitoring interdependencies across teams as the programme evolves.

- Identify and manage risks across the programme, working with team leads to mitigate blockers before they affect delivery.

- Coordinate joint governance bodies (steering committees, working groups, technical committees) — agendas, materials, minutes and follow-ups — and ensure decisions are documented and actioned.

- Communicate status clearly to internal leadership and external partners, surfacing decisions and trade-offs as they arise.

- Maintain project documentation, decision logs and operational hygiene to a standard that supports a multi-year, partnered effort.

- Coordinate resource allocation and operational support across the computational and wet lab teams where required.

- Identify and embed improvements to ways of working as the programme evolves.

Professionally, you will have 

Domain Expertise 

- A degree in life sciences, project management, or a related field; advanced degree or equivalent industry experience welcome.

- Significant Programme/Project management experience in biotech, pharma, or comparable scientific R&D settings, ideally including early-stage discovery programmes (target ID through to candidate selection), sufficient to operate as the senior Project manager for a major, multi-year effort.

- Comfort managing a programme where scope and workstreams may evolve significantly as science matures from exploratory biology through to a defined lead series.

- Scientific literacy sufficient to engage credibly with discussions spanning wet lab biology, single-cell omics, and machine learning, and enough grounding in the discovery pipeline (target validation, hit-to-lead, lead optimisation) to track progress and flag risk without needing to do the science yourself.

- Familiarity with stage-gate or portfolio governance frameworks as applied to early discovery programmes (e.g. go/no-go criteria, TPP evolution, milestone-based progression).

- Experience overseeing third-party or outsourced work packages (e.g. CROs, academic collaborators, specialist service providers) — tracking deliverables, timelines, and quality against agreed scope, and escalating issues appropriately.

PM Technical Specifics 

- Fluency with modern project management methodologies, artifacts and tools (e.g. MS Project, Smartsheet, Asana, Jira; Gantt, RAID logs).

- Strong organisational skills with a record of managing complex, interdependent works treams in matrixed environments. Comfort with the operational realities of R&D projects

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to write clearly for senior external audiences.

Desirable, not essential (IND progression): 

- Awareness of the discovery-to-IND pathway and its major inflection points (IND-enabling tox, CMC/formulation, DMPK, regulatory strategy) sufficient to anticipate future PM needs, even if this programme doesn't reach that stage during the role's tenure.

- Any exposure to pre-IND regulatory interactions or translational/preclinical handover

Personally, you 

Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams.

Take ownership of your work , proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work.

Communicate openly and directly , give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect.

Actively seek out diverse perspectives , build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams.

Embrace challenges with openness and resilience , set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Working Style & Culture at Relation 

At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment , where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! The patient is waiting! 

Recruitment Agencies 

Please note that Relation does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Resumes should not be forwarded to our job aliases or employees. Relation will not be liable for any fees associated with unsolicited CVs.

title: Business Development Representative (DACH)
description:
About Docker 

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker is seeking a results-oriented Business Development Representative . The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with a proven track record of success in qualifying leads for commercial and enterprise-level accounts.

Responsibilities: 

- Use prospecting strategies to reach out to existing users of Docker that demonstrate a propensity to acquire commercial licenses

- Identify the needs and challenges of the prospective customer

- Determine the prospect's interest in Docker

- Schedule discovery meetings for sales representatives and prospects

- Achieve a target number of qualified prospects and new opportunities

- Respond to and qualify incoming inquiries regarding interest in Docker products

- Craft a great first impression to our prospects and customers by adding value during every customer touchpoint

- Partner with cross-functional teams to share customer feedback

- Engage in team development and mentoring

Qualifications: 

- Proficiency in German and English required; French/Spanish is a bonus

- 1+ years of work experience in a Sales role

- A demonstrated track record of success

- Proactive and driven

- Excellent phone, writing, and listening skills

- A propensity and willingness to gain a strong understanding of the industry and basic use cases/value propositions that our product offers

- High integrity and a team-first mentality

- Detail-oriented and strong work ethic

- 4-year college degree or equivalent experience preferred

What to Expect 

First 30 days 

- You will be welcomed with a first-in-class onboarding experience that includes equipment setup, a sweet swag package, and a collaborative training program

- You will learn how to navigate through award-winning sales tools such as; Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Common Room, Outreach, Sales Navigator, and Docker

- You will begin core SDR functions; prospecting, lead qualification, appointment setting go, warm handoffs, Salesforce hygiene, and pipeline management.

- You will work closely with your manager, shadow your peers, and partner with your Account Executive to develop prospecting strategies and campaigns unique to your territory

- At the end of your first month, you will have a proficient grasp of the tools and activities necessary to be successful in your role

First 60 Days 

- During your second month, you will be laser-focused on company research and identify target accounts and prospecting strategies in your territory

- Build prospecting lists for target accounts and key decision-makers and then reach out to them using all communication channels (cold calls, email, chat, and social media)

- You will comprehend and maintain in-depth knowledge of Docker’s products and have a great pitch

- Adhere to team KPI metrics and prospecting standards

- You will have an advanced understanding of tools, activities, and best practices to be successful in the BDR role

First 90 Days 

- In month three, you will be confident in your craft and ready to immerse yourself in your day job fully

- You will continue efforts to improve messaging, processes, and daily activities

- You will be an accomplished lead qualifier and an expert with tools and processes

- You will be ready to operate independently at full speed

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role. 

Compensation & Equity 

EU: €58.1K – €83K OTE + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information 

- Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

- AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

- Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits 

- Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

- Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

- Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

- Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

- Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

- Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

- Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

- Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

- Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

- Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

title: Customer Support Engineer - London
description:
We’re Heidi. 

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role 

As a Support Engineer at Heidi, you’ll apply deep technical expertise to diagnose, resolve, and prevent complex issues in our AI-powered healthcare product.

Your work directly impacts product reliability, customer trust, and Heidi’s ability to scale safely in high-stakes clinical environments. By owning technical issues end-to-end and partnering closely with engineering and product teams, you’ll play a critical role in supporting clinicians, improving patient care, and contributing to the long-term success of our company.

What you’ll do 

- Act as an escalation point for customers and internal team members on complex or technical issues particularly for escalated or high-impact cases.

- Become a product expert, developing a deep understanding of how Heidi works and how customers use it in real-world clinical contexts.

- Provide exceptional technical support by clearly understanding customer needs, communicating effectively, and resolving issues accurately and efficiently.

- Perform in-depth analysis and debugging of complex technical issues, applying sound judgment and care in high-trust healthcare environments.

- Own customer issues from initial contact through to resolution, ensuring timely, accurate responses within agreed service levels.

- Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to understand, reproduce, and resolve complex technical problems - ensuring escalations are clearly documented well-scoped, and aligned with customer impact.

- Monitor server health, system status, and bug reports, taking immediate action to mitigate impact, escalate critical issues, and prevent recurring problems.

- Proactively identify systemic or recurring issues and contribute to improvements across tooling, processes, and systems that increase product reliability, support efficiency, and the team’s ability to scale, including helping identify and address recurring issues.

What you'll need 

- 2+ years’ experience in a support engineer role.

- A proactive individual who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and enjoys collaborating with an international team dedicated to building impactful AI experiences.

- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically and learn on the fly.

- Strong customer focus - you excel at and genuinely enjoy helping customers.

- Excellent communication skills, including the ability to question, clarify, empathise, use appropriate tone and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users in a clear, empathetic manner.

- Understanding of web development, with some experience using Python, React, Node, FastAPI, and MongoDB.

How we show up 

- Build for the next decade, not next quarter . Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

- Lead, don't wait . We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

- Follow the evidence . Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

description:
ABOUT QUINCE 

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE 

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices -done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency, harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where T2 and T3 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent, and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving material cost at or near should-costing, below market indices, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business,contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global procurement strategy.

RESPONSIBILITIES: 

- Commodity Insights: Establish a monitoring framework to forecast global market shifts, raw material fluctuations, currency risks, and macro-material trends. Deliver actionable intelligence to procurement and leadership on a regular cadence.

- Build and operationalize a live tracking system for key raw material prices, currency movements, and supply risks to proactively surface threats and opportunities.

- Upstream Cost Engineering: Construct and scale material-specific clean sheets to lock in baseline component costs before finished-goods production. Provide the costing foundation for Tier 1 negotiations.

- Build material-specific clean sheets for all top raw material inputs to create pricing transparency and support Tier 1 negotiation. 

- Support Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin target. 

- Partner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing) 

- Tier 2 (and Tier 3) Vendor Strategy: Map and design an upstream network strategy to consolidate raw material volumes across key material types and maximize direct-to-mill leverage. Reduce supply chain complexity while improving cost and availability. 

- Complete mapping of the Tier 2 and Tier 3 vendor landscape and deliver a defined material and vendor strategy that reduces complexity, ensures capacity, and increases direct-to-mill buying power. 

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions. 

- Material RFPs: Design and execute RFPs tailored specifically to raw material vendors, yarn spinners/mills, tanneries, and textile mills. Own the full bidding process from vendor outreach through award. 

- Consistently deliver product exceptional material cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations 

- Negotiate and execute immediate cost-reduction agreements directly with Tier 2 material suppliers, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term material maturity and sustainable competitive advantage. 

- Partner directly with the Material Sourcing, Product Sourcing and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing. 

- Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays. 

- E.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)? 

REQUIREMENTS: 

- 12-15 years of experience in raw material sourcing, commodity procurement, or upstream supply chain management 

- Deep knowledge of textile raw materials including yarns, fibers, fabrics, leather, and related commodities 

- Experience negotiating directly with mills, tanneries, yarn spinners, and raw material vendors 

- Familiarity with commodity hedging frameworks and global market indices 

- Proven ability to build and execute material-specific clean sheets 

- Strong analytical and financial modeling skills; comfort with large data sets 

- Technical aptitude for leveraging AI-powered platforms (e.g., LLMs) to conduct scenario analysis and automate complex procurement tasks.Experience in upstream supply chain network design or consolidation preferred 

- Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, sourcing, and production teams 

- Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree a plus

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist

📍 Location - London 

Who We Are: 
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we've raised over £150 million for UK charities. That's millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We're only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job 

As our Senior Data Scientist, you’ll be a hands-on member of our Data & Analytics team, working across Omaze’s core commercial and product domains. You’ll design, build and deploy predictive models and statistical frameworks that directly inform how we acquire, convert and retain customers, and how we understand their long-term value.

You’ll own end-to-end model development across areas including subscriber churn, site and funnel conversion, customer lifetime value and propensity modelling for segmentation and targeting.

You’ll also play a central role in strengthening our experimentation programme, helping us design robust A/B and multivariate tests and ensuring we apply the right statistical methodologies to interpret and act on results with confidence.

Working closely with Product, Marketing, Commercial and Engineering, you’ll turn complex data into clear decisions and useful solutions — ultimately helping Omaze become number one for charitable impact globally.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing 

- Build, validate and iterate on predictive models for churn, conversion, customer lifetime value and customer segmentation using tabular machine-learning techniques, including gradient-boosted trees, logistic regression and survival models.

- Own statistical methodology for our experimentation programme, including power analysis, test design, sequential testing, multiple-comparison corrections and pre-registered decision frameworks.

- Develop propensity and uplift models to support targeting, personalisation and marketing effectiveness measurement.

- Write production-quality code in Python and/or R, partnering with Data Engineering to deploy models into our data warehouse and downstream systems.

- Work with Product and Marketing teams to translate commercial questions into well-scoped analytical and modelling problems.

- Communicate model outputs, experiment results and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, helping stakeholders understand both statistical and practical significance.

- Contribute to how the Data & Analytics team works, including code review standards, documentation and reproducibility.

- Build models that are not only technically robust, but operationally useful — with a focus on delivering measurable impact for our customers, our business and our charity partners.

🤩 About You 

- You have proven experience in applied data science, machine learning or quantitative analytics.

- You have strong hands-on experience building supervised learning models using real-world tabular data, including classification, regression and/or survival analysis.

- You have experience with gradient-boosted tree frameworks such as XGBoost, LightGBM or CatBoost.

- You have a strong grounding in experimental design and statistical inference, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, power analysis and multiple-testing corrections.

- You have experience designing and analysing A/B tests; experience with sequential testing or Bayesian approaches would be a bonus.

- You’re proficient in Python and/or R and comfortable working across feature engineering, model training, evaluation and deployment.

- You have strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale data warehouses and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift.

- You understand model validation approaches such as cross-validation and time-based splits, and know how to manage challenges including missing data, class imbalance, data leakage and changing distributions.

- You understand causal inference concepts such as difference-in-differences, propensity score matching and uplift modelling, and can identify when causal or predictive approaches are most appropriate.

- You’re comfortable with customer analytics concepts such as churn, lifetime value, cohort analysis and retention.

- You can distinguish between statistical and practical significance and explain complex findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

- You’re collaborative and pragmatic, with a focus on shipping useful, high-quality solutions rather than pursuing theoretical perfection.

- Experience in a subscription, e-commerce or marketplace business, or with ML pipeline and model deployment tooling, would be a plus.

- A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Physics or another quantitative discipline is useful; a Master’s or PhD is desirable but not required.

🙌 What’s In It For You 

- Generous stock options scheme

- 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

- Private medical and dental insurance

- 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

- A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

- Enhanced family leave policies

- Life assurance of 4x your salary
