Als verlängerter Arm unserer Kund:innen und strategische Stimme von WeCreate sorgst du dafür, dass aus Plattform- und Community-Signalen klare Entscheidungen, relevante Aktivierungen und messbare Markenwirkung werden. 

Deine Rolle 

Du verantwortest eigenständig Kund:innen Etats im Daily Business und führst sie sicher durch ihr Full-Social-System. Dabei steuerst du sowohl strategisch als auch operativ: von der Plattformstrategie und Aktivierungsplanung über Content, Community und Creator bis hin zu Performance, Budget und Wirtschaftlichkeit. 

Du denkst Social nicht in einzelnen Gewerken, sondern als integriertes System. Du hältst Markenführung, kreative Qualität, operative Umsetzung, Paid Media und Business-Ziele zusammen mit klarer Haltung, strukturiertem Account Management und einem sicheren Gespür dafür, was auf Plattformen und in Communities funktioniert. 

Dein Impact bei WeCreate 

Du agierst als verlängerter Arm deiner Kund:innen und zugleich als strategische Stimme von WeCreate. Du schaffst Orientierung, wenn Plattformen, Trends und Anforderungen in Bewegung sind, und hältst Markenambition, kreative Exzellenz, operative Umsetzung und wirtschaftliche Ziele zusammen. 

Du bist mehr als Schnittstelle: Du erkennst, was eine Marke jetzt braucht, übersetzt es in klare Social-Maßnahmen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kund:innen Systeme, die langfristig Relevanz aufbauen und Wachstum ermöglichen. 

Das erwartet dich: - Strategisches Account Management: Du führst Kund:innen eigenständig auf Senior-Level, berätst sie zur ganzheitlichen Full-Social-Präsenz und baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf.
- Strategische und operative Steuerung: Du übersetzt Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Aktivierungspläne und priorisierte To-dos – auch über mehrere Projekte hinweg.
- Channel Ownership: Du entwickelst plattformgerechte Strategien und stellst sicher, dass Inhalte zu Marke, Zielgruppe, Community und Plattformlogik passen.
- Projekt-, Produktions- und Content-Steuerung: Du verantwortest Social-Aktivierungen, Redaktionsplanung und Produktionen von der Konzeption bis zur Freigabe. Dabei sicherst du markenkonsistenten, plattformnativen Content mit klarer Wirkungserwartung.
- Creator- und Community-Management: Du steuerst Creator-Kooperationen ganzheitlich – von Auswahl und Verhandlung bis zu Briefing und Auswertung. Community-Learnings und kulturelle Signale übersetzt du in relevante Empfehlungen.
- Performance-, Budget- und Paid-Media-Kompetenz: Du interpretierst Daten, leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab, steuerst Budgets und Wirtschaftlichkeit und integrierst Paid Media in deine Full-Funnel-Beratung.
- Fachliches Sparring und Systementwicklung: Du entwickelst Standards für Creator Management, Measurement und AI-gestützte Prozesse weiter, bringst dein Wissen ins Team ein und stärkst Strategie- und Creative-Kompetenz.

Das bringst du mit: Das sind deine Kernkompetenzen 

- Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Prioritäten und umsetzbare Pläne übersetzen. 

- Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung anspruchsvoller Kund:innenetats oder Retainer – von Beratung und Planung bis Umsetzung, Performance-Review und Weiterentwicklung. 

- Du beherrschst Full Social: Plattformstrategie, Content-Systeme, Community, Creator und Paid Media gehören für dich zu einer wirksamen Markenführung zusammen. 

- Du steuerst Projekte, Budgets, Aufwände und Stakeholder vorausschauend und kannst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge in klare Entscheidungen übersetzen. 

- Du bringst Erfahrung im Creator Management mit – inklusive Auswahl, Verhandlung, Briefing, Steuerung, Qualitätskontrolle und Auswertung. 

- Du kannst Daten und Reportings analytisch einordnen, strategische Implikationen ableiten und Handlungsempfehlungen klar vermitteln. 

- Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken, Content und Plattformkultur und kannst kreative Qualität konstruktiv, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe führen. 

So arbeitest du 

- Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch. 

- Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und proaktiv – auch wenn sich Prioritäten, Plattformen oder Anforderungen verändern. 

- Du erkennst früh, wo Abstimmung oder Steuerung nötig ist, und handelst entsprechend – mit Kund:innen, Creator:innen und im Team. 

- Du hältst strategische Prioritäten auch bei hohem Tempo im Blick und schaffst Orientierung, wenn viele Themen gleichzeitig laufen. 

- Du hast Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu sparren und Arbeitsweisen gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln. 

Das bekommst du bei uns: Flexibilität mit Verbindung 

- Hybrides Arbeiten mit unserem Office in Hamburg als Team-Hub 

- Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat gemeinsames Arbeiten im Office für integrierte Teamarbeit 

- Flexibles Arbeiten von zuhause und wenn du Lust auf einen Perspektivwechsel hast, nach Absprache zeitweise aus dem Ausland 

- Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate 

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine Arbeitsweise, die zu deinem Alltag passt 

- Freie Wahl deiner Hardware 

Benefits, die dir wirklich etwas bringen 

- Gemeinsame Events und Workations, weil gute Zusammenarbeit nicht nur im Kalender entsteht 

- Wahlweise Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Probonio-Gutschein oder Urban Sports Club 

- Bagel-Frühstück im Office für einen gemeinsamen Start in den Tag 

Und sonst? 

- Kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen in deine Expertise 

- Eine steile Lernkurve – ohne Dauer-Überstunden als vermeintliches Karriereprogramm 

- Raum, eine wachsende Agentur und unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten 

- Flache Hierarchien sowie ein respektvoller, offener Umgang miteinander 

Hinweis zur Anstellung: 

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet – mit Option auf Verlängerung bzw. Übernahme in ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis. 

Klingt nach dir? 

Dann bewirb dich über unser Karriereportal: 

https://wecreate-germany-gmbh.jobs.personio.de/ 

Ein CV reicht uns erst einmal. Und: Bewirb dich auch dann, wenn du nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 Prozent erfüllst. 

WeCreate möchte einen inklusiven, diversen und authentischen Arbeitsplatz schaffen. Vielleicht bist genau du die Person, die diese Rolle weiterdenkt. Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Role description As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on. 

Your Mission - Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
- Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
- Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead. 
- Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees. 
- Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables. 
- Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods. 

Minimum Qualifications - Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure. 
- Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments. 
- Strong analytical and problem solving skills. 
- Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress. 
- Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit. 
- Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1). 
- Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking. 

Preferred Qualifications - Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation.
- IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus. 
- Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment. 
- Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats. 
- Experience with Jira and Confluence. 
- Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation. 

Why you'll love working here - Attraktive Aufgaben in einem international agierenden, wachsenden Familienunternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten

- Teilnahme an jährlichen 360° Feedback-Loops mit klaren Aufstiegskriterien und einem individuellen Karrierepfad 
- Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag in einem Unternehmen, das Eigenverantwortung und persönliches Wachstum fördert

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager (German Speaking)
description:
As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will proactively drive new product attachment and effective strong relationships across our largest and most strategic customers. You’ll advocate for the customer internally and focus on a positive customer experience. Interactions are rooted in relationship-management, first and foremost, while also advocating for growth opportunities. Enterprise Customer Success Managers follow a well-defined methodology that helps them identify the customer's unique needs and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 

What You’ll Do: 

- Act as a strategic partner to customers, orchestrating cross-functional internal teams and engaging executive, technical, and business stakeholders to understand customer goals and translate them into a clear, deliverable Datadog value narrative.

- Proactively build and maintain executive relationships to deliver clear, outcome-driven value stories that connect Datadog technical use cases to measurable business results.

- Lead QBRs and strategic reviews as a forum to demonstrate impact, align on priorities, and define next-step initiatives.

- Analyze adoption and usage trends to quantify value delivered, extract insights from large datasets, identify gaps, and drive financially grounded commercial recommendations and strategic opportunities. 

- Position Datadog as a critical observability platform that enables reliability, efficiency, and informed decision-making.

- Own and project manage the on-boarding process for new customers

- Collaborate cross-functionally with AEs, SEs, TAM, Product, Support, Enablement and other technical teams to ensure consistent value delivery and messaging.

- With demonstrated understanding of observability and security platforms, align customers technical and business objectives to our platform offerings

Who You Are: 

- Customer-centric with 3+ years in a Customer Success or Account Management role

- Able to manage a wide portfolio of accounts rolling up to large enterprise corporate accounts

- Knowledgeable in working with Fortune 1000 companies and global brands across all industries

- A strong communicator with exceptional attention to detail and an ability to cater to a specific audience, including CTO, VP of Engineering and DevOps professionals

- Experienced in the B2B tech space or with SaaS companies

- Able to travel for customer onsite visits and events as required 

- Fluent in written and spoken English and German

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 

Benefits and Growth: 

- Best-in-breed onboarding

- Generous global benefits

- Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

- New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

- Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

- An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. 

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. title: Account Associate - Retail & Grocery (H/F)
description:
Our Global Structure 

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de transformer la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses. Chez Deliveroo, impact, innovation et croissance sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les livreurs partenaires pour donner à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elle veut, comme elle le veut, quand elle le veut et où elle le veut.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Ce que vous ferez au quotidien 

En tant que Account Associate - Retail & Grocery (H/F) , vous serez responsable du succès d’un portefeuille de partenaires, afin d’assurer la meilleure expérience à nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un partenariat solide et durable avec nos eux pour notre application.

- Analysez la performance de votre portefeuille et prenez les mesures adéquates, faites des recommandations, soyez agile et ouvert à la nouveauté.

- Optimisation et gestion de Processus : Deliveroo est une société qui évolue à grande vitesse et à grande échelle. Vous aurez l’opportunité de créer et améliorer des processus, par exemple la gestion de partenariats pour contribuer à la croissance. Vous élaborerez des documents de meilleures pratiques pour des comptes spécifiques et pour l'ensemble du portefeuille

- Relations avec les magasins Retail et/ou Grocery : Vous gérerez le développement des partenariats, le suivi des données, et vous assurerez une expérience optimale sur l’application afin de faire de Deliveroo le service de livraison à domicile de référence, en apportant votre expertise Food Tech en étant l'expert de votre zone / ville.

- Vous veillerez au suivi du respect des engagements contractuels pris avec les partenaires de votre portefeuille.

Ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir 

- Expérience : stage ou alternance dans un rôle d’Account management ou commercial. Une expérience terrain au sein d’un grand groupe (idéalement supermarché, marketplace, ecommerce, retailer, FMCG) est un vrai atout.

- Commercial : vous avez à cœur de négocier, d’anticiper des discussions commerciales, d’entreprendre des actions afin de maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociations de mise en place d'outils commerciaux, etc)

- Entrepreneur : vous avez le goût pour entreprendre, créer, aller chercher des opportunités, en sachant prendre de la hauteur mais sans jamais se couper du terrain et de votre téléphone pour comprendre vos partenaires.

- Analytique : capable d’être synthétique, d'approfondir les données et de comprendre les données qui permettent d'améliorer les performances pour nos partenaires en magasins.

- Proactif(-ive) dans vos relations avec les interlocuteurs. Vous adorez être sur le terrain et vous êtes impliqué(e) dans tout ce qui est opérationnel dans votre périmètre.

- Centré sur le client : être obsédé par nos clients. Utiliser des données quantitatives et qualitatives pour construire un service qui soit opérationnellement excellent pour nos clients.

- Jouer en équipe : un joueur d'équipe qui collabore et qui est capable de tirer le meilleur parti des personnes qui vous entourent. Capable de travailler efficacement à tous les niveaux de Deliveroo et de réussir avec et par les autres.

- Optimiste, confiant et plein d'énergie : vous apportez de la fraîcheur, de l'énergie et de la passion dans l'équipe. Vous contribuez à créer un environnement de travail unique, propice aux nouvelles idées et agréable pour les autres personnes impliquées.

- Langues : Français et Anglais courant indispensables. 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Nous sommes des passionnés de food, des problem-solvers, des créateurs de communauté et bien plus encore. Ce qui nous rassemble : un esprit entrepreneurial fort et l’envie de construire quelque chose d’ambitieux ensemble.

🔧 Une grande autonomie pour avoir un impact concret sur votre portefeuille et nos partenaires.
🌱 Un environnement stimulant favorisant l’apprentissage, le développement et l’évolution de carrière.
💙 Des avantages pensés pour le bien-être et l’équilibre de nos équipes.
🌍 Une culture inclusive, internationale et collaborative où chacun peut trouver sa place.

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. 

Prêt(e) à contribuer au futur de la foodtech ? Postulez dès aujourd’hui !

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion 

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Technicien.ne de maintenance (Evreux)
description:

Chez Exotec , nous concevons et maintenons des systèmes robotiques de pointe qui transforment les entrepôts dans le monde entier. Chaque jour, notre technologie contribue à rendre les opérations plus sûres, plus rapides et moins exigeantes physiquement. - systèmes de convoyage,
- roulements,
- courroies,
- chaînes,

- moteurs,
- variateurs,
- capteurs,
- actionneurs.

title: Senior Manager Technical Operations (Bauleiter) - Remote (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen … Dich, als Senior Manager Technical Operations (Bauleiter) (m/w/d) , um gemeinsam mit uns bei thermondo einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Klimaneutralität zu leisten. Mit Deinem Interesse an erneuerbaren Energien und Deiner Identifikation mit unseren Werten, unser Wort zählt, jeden Tag besser und zusammen stärker , schaffst Du einen echten Mehrwert für uns alle.

Wenn Du daran Spaß hast - Planungs- und Installationsstandard B2B/MFH aufbauen: Entwicklung, Dokumentation und laufende Weiterentwicklung eines verbindlichen technischen Standards für Wärmepumpen-Projekte im Mehrfamilienhaus im Bestand. Dazu gehören Heizlast, Hydraulik inklusive Kaskaden und Pufferspeicher, Trinkwarmwasser und Legionellenschutz, Elektro und Netzanschluss, Schallschutz sowie Aufstellung. Der Standard ist die Grundlage für Planung, Angebotskalkulation und Ausführung durch unsere Installationspartner.
- Technische Baustellenbegleitung: Prüfung und Freigabe der Planungen und Angebote der Installationspartner, Kick-off vor Ort, regelmäßige Baustellenbesuche und Qualitätskontrollen, Klärung technischer Fragen und Änderungen im Bauablauf. Du bist technische Schnittstelle zu Kunden aus der Wohnungswirtschaft und zu Eigentümern, Partnern, Fachplanern und Netzbetreibern.
- Abnahmen und Inbetriebnahme verantworten: Durchführung und Dokumentation von Zwischen- und Endabnahmen, einschließlich Inbetriebnahme, hydraulischem Abgleich, Einregulierung und Funktionsprüfung. Du verantwortest das Mängelmanagement bis zur mängelfreien Übergabe an Kunden und Service. Außerdem standardisiert du Abnahme- und Übergabeprotokolle sowie die Nachweisdokumentation für die Förderung nach BEG und KfW.
- Skalierbare Operations-Prozesse aufbauen: Definition und Implementierung des End-to-End-Prozesses von der technischen Vorprüfung über Planung, Material und Bestellung, Ausführung, Abnahme und Übergabe in den Service. Dazu gehören Checklisten, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, Meilensteine, KPIs wie Durchlaufzeit, Erstabnahme Quote und Nacharbeitsquote sowie Anforderungen an Tools wie CRM, Angebotsgenerator und Baustellendokumentation.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description:
The product you will work on The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. 

Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform. 

The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production. 

This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field. 

Your role and responsibilities You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams. 

Build the platform 

- Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters. 

- Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions. 

- Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment. 

- Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations. 

- Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services. 

- Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior 

- . 

Run what you build 

- Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code. 

- Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations. 

- Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code. 

- Be part of a compensated on-call rotation 

Set the technical direction 

- Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind. 

- Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate. 

- Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes. 

What you need to succeed in this role - Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems. 

- Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on. 

- Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy. 

- Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today. 

- Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack. 

- Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation. 

- A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change. 

- A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation. 

- Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems. 

- Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone. 

- Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists. 

- Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it. 

- A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone. 

- Experience in using AI for engineering. 

Nice to haves - Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production. 

- Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations. 

- Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it. 

- Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security. 

- Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6. 

- Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry. 

- Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects 

We offer you At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme. 

You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.

title: Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
Who we are and what you’ll do HOLOPLOT is seeking a decisive, technically strong and business-oriented Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), to lead our 20-person software engineering organization, drive cross-functional delivery, and own the long-term software architecture for our high-performance audio products. 

Working closely with engineering leads who focus on deep technical problem-solving and team mentorship, this role leads overall software delivery, strategic technical vision, and cross-departmental alignment. 

Main objectives of the role As Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end delivery of HOLOPLOT’s software ecosystem, spanning embedded and distributed Linux systems, audio DSP, 3D/GPU, C++, Rust and web-based front-end applications, Kubernetes cluster and cloud infrastructure. You will act as the operational bridge between software engineering, hardware development, research, product, customer success teams, and key enterprise clients. You will work closely with the Director of Product for Software as well as the CPO, and report to the CTO. 

Your role and responsibilities - Strategic Software Vision & Architecture : Own and drive the strategic vision for the technical backbone of the HOLOPLOT product ecosystem. Proactively identify architectural risks and ensure performance and scalability across embedded hardware, audio processing platforms, and user interfaces. 

- Execution & High-Stakes Delivery : Take full accountability for software delivery timeliness, quality, and reliability. Proactively lead critical client-facing missions, OS rollouts, and on-site integration handovers (e.g., venue acceptance testing and integration protocols), including regular international travel 

- High-Performing Mission-Driven Teams : Attract, grow, and retain strong engineering talent to build highly successful, cross-functional product development teams. Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, agency, and innovation that drives high employee engagement, productivity, and strong outcomes for our customers. 

- Cross-Functional Alignment : Drive seamless collaboration between Software, Research, Customer Success, Product Management, and external technical partners (such as client IT security and external system integrators). Eliminate inter-departmental friction and establish clear integration pathways. 

- Business-First Leadership : Together with Product, align software priorities and architecture directly with HOLOPLOT’s strategic and commercial objectives. Make decisive, well-reasoned trade-offs under pressure while optimizing engineering output for maximum company value. 

- Operational Leadership & Partnering : Partner with dedicated Engineering Managers and Tech Leads who oversee team culture, individual mentoring, and deeply technical topics. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Focus your impact on operational discipline, accountability, and clear departmental direction. 

- AI Strategy & Development Workflows : Define and execute HOLOPLOT's AI strategy for software development. Integrate AI-assisted engineering tools, automated workflows, and emerging AI technologies into the software development life cycle to elevate team productivity and explore modern product capabilities. 

- Platform, Quality & Operational Excellence: Ensure high standards of quality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all software solutions. Identify, assess, and mitigate technological risks, including technical debt and platform lifecycle challenges. Define and improve engineering processes, development standards, and tooling to enable predictable, high-quality delivery. 

- Security, Compliance & Risk Management: Drive HOLOPLOT’s technology security strategy, including cybersecurity, data protection, and secure-by-design principles. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, validation/certifications, and regulatory requirements. Ensure systems are resilient, reliable, and fit for production and customer use. 

What you need to succeed in this role - Engineering Leadership : Extensive experience managing software teams of significant size (15-30+ engineers) in complex, multi-disciplinary technology environments 

- Deep-Tech Literacy : Comfortable navigating a highly heterogeneous tech stack encompassing Low-Level/Embedded C++ & Rust, Audio DSP, 3D/GPU rendering, Linux, Kubernetes, NATS, gRPC, JUCE, CI/CD and Web services. 

- Track Record of Ownership : Proven experience driving complex hardware-software product rollouts and managing high-stakes client or partner integrations end-to-end. 

- Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management : Strong diplomacy and technical communication skills, with a track record of bridging engineering teams with business, product, research, and client stakeholders. 

- Pragmatic Decision-Making : Ability to operate with high clarity and a steady hand in fast-paced environments, prioritizing long-term product stability over short-term friction. 

- AI-Driven Development Strategy : Demonstrated experience establishing AI-development strategies and driving the practical adoption of AI-assisted software development, LLM tooling, or automated engineering workflows. 

- Audio Software and Hardware Products: Experience with the Pro Audio and Music Technology product space, as both developer and user. 

We offer you At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with the scope and impact of this leadership role, along with perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme. 

You'll join an international, open-minded team and work directly with our C-level, engineering and product leads, as well as cross-functional stakeholders in customer success, research, and operations. You'll shape the strategic direction of our software architecture, own high-stakes delivery for cutting-edge audio technology, and drive the AI-assisted development strategy for a 20-person software engineering team, with the autonomy and accountability that comes with a senior leadership mandate.

Gemeinsam großartig – werde Teil des Teams Du willst als Software Engineer mit Python , APIs und Automatisierungen an Lösungen arbeiten, die direkt im operativen Alltag eingesetzt werden? In dieser Rolle entwickelst du interne Tools, Services und Schnittstellen, übersetzt Anforderungen aus den Fachbereichen in pragmatische technische Lösungen und verbindest bestehende Systeme sinnvoll miteinander. Dabei arbeitest du mit modernen Webtechnologien, Datenbanken und API-basierten Integrationen und entwickelst deine Lösungen von ersten Prototypen und MVPs Schritt für Schritt zu stabilen, wartbaren Anwendungen weiter.

Deine Mission - Du entwickelst neue und bestehende interne Anwendungen und Services mit Python weiter und setzt konkrete Anforderungen aus unserem operativen Geschäft technisch um.
- Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen daran, Business-Anforderungen zu verstehen, zu strukturieren und daraus pragmatische technische Lösungsansätze, Prototypen und MVPs zu entwickeln.
- Du erkennst gemeinsam mit dem Team Automatisierungs- und Optimierungspotenziale und verbindest bestehende Systeme über APIs, Datenbanken und Schnittstellen.
- Du entwickelst funktionierende Prototypen zu stabilen und wartbaren Lösungen weiter und bekommst bei Architekturfragen sowie der Integration in zentrale Systeme Unterstützung und Sparring aus unserem technischen Team und dem Core Platform Team.
- Du sorgst mit sauberem und testbarem Code, automatisierten Tests und verständlicher technischer Dokumentation für die Qualität deiner Lösungen und nutzt moderne AI-Tools dort, wo sie deine Arbeit sinnvoll unterstützen.

Deine Talente - Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung gesammelt und eigenständig an Anwendungen, Tools oder Automatisierungen gearbeitet. Gute Kenntnisse in Python und/oder JavaScript beziehungsweise TypeScript bringst du bereits mit.
- Du hast ein gutes Grundverständnis von APIs, Datenbanken und grundlegenden Software-Architekturen und hast bereits mit Git sowie kollaborativen Entwicklungsprozessen gearbeitet.
- Du kennst die Grundlagen von sauberem, wartbarem und testbarem Code und hast idealerweise bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit CI/CD, automatisierten Tests oder Docker. Du musst darin noch kein Profi sein.
- Du denkst gerne über die reine technische Umsetzung hinaus, interessierst dich für den Business-Kontext und hast Lust, Anforderungen gemeinsam mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern weiterzuentwickeln. Gleichzeitig bist du neugierig, lernbereit und offen für Feedback.
- Du nutzt AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor oder vergleichbare Anwendungen bereits im Entwicklungsalltag oder möchtest dich stärker damit beschäftigen und lernen, sie sinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll einzusetzen.
- Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Fachbereichen sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau für technische Dokumentation, Tools und Code.

Tech Stack 
Python | FastAPI | Docker | CI/CD | Git | SQL

Unser Angebot - #Flexibilität: Deutschlandweites Home-Office und flexible Arbeitszeiten schaffen einen Alltag, der sich an dich anpasst, und sorgen für maximale Produktivität und Work-Life-Balance. - #YourTech2Shine: Mac oder Windows? Du entscheidest. Dazu liefern wir dir die passende Home-Office-Ausstattung für maximale Produktivität.
- #StarkesDuGesundesWir: Von JobRad und Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft bis zu (Online-) Gesundheitstagen und physiotherapeutischen Massagen vor Ort, ergonomisch ausgestatteten Büros, Betriebsärztin, Vertrauensperson und umfangreichem betrieblichem Gesundheitsmanagement – wir fördern aktiv deine Gesundheit und dein Wohlbefinden.
- #Ausgewogenheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, Zeiterfassung mit Überstundenausgleich – selbstverständlich. Mit zahlreichen Sportgeräten im Office, Fitness- und Coffee-Breaks oder auch Corporate Benefits für mehr Spaß beim Shoppen setzen wir Ansätze für regenerative Pausen. Zeit ist ein Investment. In dich und uns.

- #AnkommenUndLoslegen: Wir legen Wert auf eine strukturierte Einarbeitung. Daher geben wir dir sowohl kulturell als auch fachlich alles mit, damit du dich bestmöglich entwickeln kannst.
- #GemeinsamGroßartig: Als kununu Top Company 2026 stehen bei uns Erfolg, Teamgeist und Spaß im Vordergrund. Bleib durch unsere unternehmensweiten Jourfixe am Ball und erlebe Sommerfeste, Weihnachtsfeiern, Stammtische und viele Events mehr, die unser Wir-Gefühl stärken.

Jeden Monat unterstützen wir mehrere zehntausend Menschen dabei, nachhaltige Energielösungen zu finden und einfach richtige Entscheidungen zu treffen. Wir gehen die Hürde zwischen Verbrauchenden und Anbietenden mit unseren Online-Angebotsvergleichen an, ermitteln die individuellen Bedürfnisse der Anfragenden und bringen sie mit den passenden Anbietenden zusammen – ein Win-Win für alle.

title: Chief of Staff (Strategy & Operations)(All Genders)
description:
Hey! Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves. Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too. That's exactly what we're building every single day. 

tl;dr We're looking for a Chief of Staff who works closely with Nik to structurally build out our company- & org processes. 

Main information - Start: immediately (flexible start)
- Location: Cologne
- Workload: Full-time
- Team: Founder's Office

Is this a match? The most important basics – so we both know if it could work. 
- Location: You’ll be based at our office in Cologne (Belgisches Viertel) and should be on site at least twice a week.
- Experience: You have 5–8 years of experience in strategy & operations and feel confident in your role.
- Languages are no problem: You speak German and English fluently.
- Your connection to football: You're genuinely interested in amateur football and have a feel for what moves this community.
- Start-up spirit: You prefer to play an active part in shaping things rather than just going through the motions – even if that sometimes means tackling things without a ready-made roadmap.

What you'll do - your playing field This is how you move our mission forward every day. - End-to-end ownership of selected strategic and operational projects from concept to execution
- Building and continuously improving central company processes
- Close collaboration with Nik on cross-functional strategic projects and prioritization
- Supporting process optimization in other operational areas as needed
- Preparing decision-making materials and analyses for the founder team

What you bring to the team We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points. - Strong process- and structure-oriented thinking, even in ambiguity
- Experience independently executing projects in a fast-growing environment
- Tools: Notion, project management tool, Google Workspace, Slack
Good to know 
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one. - This role is significantly more hands-on than the title might suggest: you don't just plan, you execute, and take ownership across shifting topic areas. The exact focus will be sharpened further together with the team. If you're looking for pure strategy work without hands-on execution, this role isn't for you. 

Bonus Not a must – but this'll definitely earn you extra points. 
- Experience in a high-growth startup
- Early experience building People/org processes

The Prematch Setup We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now. 
- Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
- Modern tech setup - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
- AI-powered work - We use AI tools to work smarter and more efficiently, and provide you with the tools you need to make the most of AI in your day-to-day work.
- 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
- Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
- Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
- Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
- Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
- Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.

Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match. If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special. Maybe this is exactly the moment you've been waiting for: a team that thinks big, a vision that actually moves things and the chance to help reshape amateur football digitally – together with us. Now it's your turn. - Click on ‘Apply now’ – it’ll only take 2 minutes.
- All we need is your CV. You can tell us the rest in our simple, short application form.
- Don’t meet all the requirements? If you think you’re still a good fit – just apply

title: Scientific Assistant to Vice Presidium International Affairs & University Development (m, f, d)- 30 hours
description:
Your Responsibilities We are looking for a new colleague to join the Office of the Vice President International and University Development in Berlin. The position is academically affiliated with the Vice President International and University Development and works closely with the International Office, faculties, programme directors and international partner institutions. In this position you will support the Vice President in the day-to-day coordination of priorities and activities while also taking an active role in the development and implementation of UE’s international academic partnerships, teaching collaborations, programmes and strategic initiatives. The position combines academic and organisational support, coordination of international teaching and cooperation projects, research and strategic development. It serves as an important interface between the Vice President International, academic and administrative units across UE and international partner universities, helping to ensure that ongoing activities and new initiatives are effectively prepared, coordinated and followed through.

Key Activities & Responsibilities:
- Coordinate ongoing international teaching collaborations, including coordination of lecturers and communication with academic partners
- Support the development and coordination of international academic projects and cooperation formats, as well as contributing to the development and implementation of UE’s Internationalisation and Sustainability Strategies and related strategic initiatives.
- Conduct research, benchmarking and analysis on international higher education, academic structures, potential partners and relevant international developments
- Provide academic and organisational support to the Vice President International in day-to-day activities
- Maintain project documentation and monitor responsibilities, deadlines and next steps across ongoing international projects
- Prepare briefings, presentations, background information and decision-making materials for the Vice President International
- Support further academic and strategic projects within the portfolio of the Vice President International and University Development

Your profile - University degree at Master’s level or equivalent in social sciences, humanities, international relations, education, management or another relevant field; a PhD is an advantage but not required
- Previous professional experience in higher education, international academic cooperation, university management or project coordination is an advantage
- Ability to work independently on new topics and to coordinate projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders
- Strong analytical, research and organisational skills
- Ability to structure complex information and prepare concise briefings, presentations and decision-making materials
- Excellent command of English and German, both written and spoken
- Strong communication and intercultural skills and the ability to interact effectively with academic staff, university management and international partners
- Structured, proactive and reliable working style with a high level of independence
- Willingness to travel occasionally
- Good command of Office 365, including MS Teams, PowerPoint, Excel and Word

Why us? - Opportunity to work with a great team in a dynamic and international environment
- 30 days of vacation /5 working days per week
- After successfully passing the probationary period, we offer subsidies for employees’ well-being through our health budget with preventive and aftercare services
- Various online language courses and opportunities to participate in online collaboration courses
- Numerous campus events from the fields of art, culture, business and science
- Opportunity to develop and implement new ideas and concept

Interested? 

Then we look forward to hearing from you. Please send your application to: Jobs at University of Europe for Applied Sciences. Your application should include the following documents: CV, Cover Letter and References and possible start date.

As an employer, we are committed to equal opportunity and support for minorities. We do not discriminate based on ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or legally protected status.

title: Senior Controller / FP&A Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Arbeiten, wo andere Urlaub machen - willkommen in unseren Paradiesen Wir bei Therme Horizon schaffen besondere Erlebnisse für unsere Gäste – und entwickeln gleichzeitig unsere Unternehmensgruppe kontinuierlich weiter. Dafür bauen wir aktuell gemeinsam mit einem internationalen Finanzinvestor eine zentrale Holdingorganisation und moderne Finance-Strukturen auf.

Als Teil unseres neu aufgebauten Group-FP&A-Teams übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der gruppenweiten finanziellen Steuerung. Du verbindest klassische FP&A-Aufgaben mit Business Performance Management, strategischer Analyse und dem Aufbau moderner Finance-Prozesse.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit der Holding, unseren lokalen Finance-Teams und dem operativen Management unserer Standorte zusammen. Deine Themen begleitest du von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein.

Der Job auf einen Blick - Planning & Forecasting : Verantwortung für Budget, Rolling Forecast und Mittelfristplanung – von der Prozessgestaltung und Abstimmung mit den Standorten bis zu Konsolidierung und Analyse 
- Performance Management: Steuerung des gruppenweiten Monatsabschluss- und Performance-Review-Prozesses sowie Analyse von Geschäftsentwicklung, Abweichungen und wesentlichen Performance-Treibern – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den lokalen Finance-Teams 
- Management Reporting: Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung des Reportings für CEO, CFO, Management und Gesellschafter inklusive der relevanten Investorenanforderungen 
- KPI-Framework & Werttreiberbäume: Entwicklung und Harmonisierung gruppenweiter KPIs und Werttreiberbäume, die die operativen Treiber des Geschäfts mit der finanziellen Performance verbinden 
- Business Cases & Ad-hoc-Analysen: Business Cases, Szenarioanalysen und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Management und Gesellschafter sowie eigenständige Bearbeitung strategischer Fragestellungen 
- Daten & Systeme: Weiterentwicklung unseres Data Warehouse hin zu einer gruppenweit konsolidierten Datenbasis über alle Gesellschaften, Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung von LucaNet als Reporting- und Konsolidierungslösung sowie perspektiv Einführung einer Planungslösung – von den fachlichen Anforderungen über die Toolauswahl bis zum Rollout, gemeinsam mit Data & IT 
- KI & Automatisierung: Identifikation und Umsetzung von Anwendungsfällen für Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI im FP&A 

Skills und Werte die zu uns passen - Abgeschlossenes wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation 
- Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Controlling oder FP&A mit fundiertem Verständnis von Planung, Forecasting und Performance Management – alternativ ein vergleichbarer Hintergrund aus Private Equity, Transaction Advisory oder Wirtschaftsprüfung mit Wechselwunsch in die Industrie 
- Starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, gepaart mit einer pragmatischen Hands-on-Mentalität und einem guten Gespür für das operative Geschäft 
- Freude daran, Strukturen und Prozesse von Grund auf aufzubauen, und die Eigenverantwortung, Themen bis zum Ergebnis zu treiben 
- Sie fühlen sich in einem dynamischen, sich schnell verändernden Umfeld wohl und gehen souverän mit wechselnden Prioritäten um 
- Sehr gute Excel- und Modellierungskenntnisse sowie ausgeprägte Daten- und Systemaffinität 
- Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Finanzthemen für Management und operative Kolleginnen und Kollegen verständlich aufzubereiten 
- Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil 
- Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen an die Standorte 

Das Plus zum Traumjob - Exklusive Mitarbeiter-Vorteile: Nutze unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen zu besonderen Konditionen – ein echtes Plus für dein Wohlbefinden
- Individuelle Entwicklungschancen: Wir investieren in dich und fördern dein Wachstum durch persönliche Weiterbildungen mit festem Budget
- Stabilität & Sicherheit: Als Teil einer gewachsenen Unternehmensgruppe profitierst du von einem starken Rückhalt, modernen Strukturen und langfristiger Arbeitsplatzsicherheit
- Mehr fürs Leben: Kita-Zuschuss, Bikeleasing, Firmenfitness und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, die über das gesetzliche Maß hinausgeht, geben dir und uns ein gutes Gefühl
- Kostenfreie Getränke & Genuss-Vorteile: Erfrischung geht auf uns – plus attraktive Essensrabatte bei unseren Partnergastronomen

Kontakt Diese Ausschreibung richtet sich ausdrücklich auch an Bewerberinnen und Bewerber mit Behinderungen, die wir in unserem Haus stets sehr gerne beschäftigen und willkommen heißen. 

Wir machen dir das Bewerben leicht: Lade ganz einfach hier dein Motivationsschreiben in deutscher Sprache, deinen Lebenslauf und deine Zeugnisse hoch, indem du auf "Jetzt bewerben" klickst. 
Wir freuen uns darauf von dir zu lesen!

title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO We are looking for a Senior Product Manager ( ISR ) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 

You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.

Tech stack & tools: - Linear (backlog, sprints) 
- Confluence 
- Google Workspace 
- LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications 
- Figma 
- QGIS and comparable viewers 
- STAC -based imagery catalogs Data: 
- very high resolution optical imagery 
- synthetic aperture radar 
- 3D surface models 
- cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments 
- agentic tools for a variety of work. 

Your challenge As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them.

- Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

- Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters.

- Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts.

- Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards.

- Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim.

- Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance.

Your profile - Professional ISR , GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry.

- Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff.

- Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control.

- German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English.

- German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). 

- Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users.

- You take ownership and proactively push work forward. 

- You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams.

- Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped.

- You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure.

- Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus.

- Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus.

- Experience writing CONOPS , operational requirements or capability documents is a plus.

- Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus.

- Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus.

- An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus.

- Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus.

Your Benefits - The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

- Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

- We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.

- Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.

- A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.

- Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.

- Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.

- Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.

- A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities

title: Senior Marketing Manager - Government Solutions (f/m/x)
description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO At LiveEO, we combine Space Technology with AI to solve problems here on Earth. Our satellite-based monitoring solutions help Infrastructure operators and industrial companies to make their operations more ecological, safer, and more efficient.

LiveEO is applying the latest developments in artificial intelligence to analyse satellite data and is bringing the insights of earth observation data to customers in the enterprise sector. LiveEO’s ambitious goal is to monitor 1 billion assets across the globe with its unique SaaS solution until 2030. Our team is as global as the satellite data we process and the customers we serve. title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities - Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

- Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

- Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

- Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

- Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

- Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

- Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

- Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

- Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

- Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

- Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

- Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

- Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

- Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

- Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions

Your profile Apply if this describes you:

- You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

- You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

- You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

- You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

- You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

- You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal

- You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents

- You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost

- You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes

- Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus

- You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own

- You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem

- You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome

- You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus

- You are based in Berlin

- You are willing to travel regularly across Europe

- Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it.

Why us? - Sell a product people are excited about

- Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead

- Work directly with the founders and senior team

- Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage

- Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation

- See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer

- Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy

- Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance

- Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets

Tips for a successful application - Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little.

- Tell us what you have personally owned and what results you produced.

- If you have built pipeline, opened a new market, sold a difficult product, or closed an unusual deal, tell us how.

- Use AI as a tool. Make sure the thinking and personality in your application are yours.

title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
description:
Your mission At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments. 
This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that. 
The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup. The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation. 
You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements. 
This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved. 

What you will work on - Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

- Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

- Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

- Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA - and NGC -based workloads

- Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

- Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

- Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

- Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

- Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

- Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

- Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

- Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC , secrets management, SSO , and tenant boundaries

- Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows

Your profile We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

- Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

- Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

- Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

- Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

- Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA , and GPU scheduling

- The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

- A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

- Very good English; German is a plus

We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.

Nice to have - Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

- Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

- Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF , photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

- Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

- Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

- Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

- Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements

Why us? Make an impact! Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact! Our teams inspire! Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things! Be authentic! Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work! Help others!
